concerns.text: The specification (FR-009) requires generation of Partial Dependence Plots (PDP) to visualize non‑linear interactions, but the only related task (T017) produces Accumulated Local Effects (ALE) plots. No task creates PDPs, leaving FR‑009 uncovered.
Success criterion SC‑002 mandates that RMSE be measured against an ASTM G59 tolerance of ≤ 150 mV, yet no task defines a check, validation, or artifact that enforces or records this threshold.
Success criterion SC‑005 requires the total pipeline execution time to be ≤ 6 hours, but there is no task that measures, logs, or asserts the overall runtime.
Constitution principle I (Reproducibility) demands that all scripts pin random seeds. No task in the list explicitly creates or verifies a seeded‑configuration file or ensures scripts use it.

Constitution principle III (Data Hygiene) requires SHA‑256 checksums for raw data files to be recorded in the project state YAML. No task generates these checksums or updates `state/projects/…yaml` accordingly.
